description: Change DNS records (create, update, delete), applied at the registrar in order. Applies at once when you act for an owner or admin and the workspace lets agents apply changes (the default); otherwise it waits in list_approvals. workflow.state says which. Values are checked first (invalid_record names the change and field). For update and delete, pass record_id from list_dns_records when a name has more than one record of that type.

record_id.description: The record to update or delete, from list_dns_records

name: stage_dns_change
title: Stage a DNS change
